    def dp(start):

        stack = [(start, 0)]
        while stack:
            current, time = stack.pop()
            if visited[current]:
                continue
            visited[current] = True
            for neighbor in graph[current]:
                stack.append((neighbor, time + 1))
        return sum(time for time in range(1, n + 1) if visited[time])
